data.detail: The upstream claim_classification_map has status 'inconclusive' with reason 'no_user_request_provided' and an empty claims array. Terminology normalization requires at least one classified claim as input. Per the fail-closed principle (CLAUDE.md Section 7), no normalization map is produced when no input claims are available.

notes: The upstream classifier returned status 'inconclusive' with reason 'no_user_request_provided'. No claim text is available for terminology evaluation.
inference_used is set true because request_classification was effectively absent — no classified claims propagated from the prior step.
This is a holding state. No terminology verdicts can be issued without input claims. Downstream gating layers should treat this output as a pass-through pending a valid classify-claims result.
No claims were provided for terminology normalization. The upstream classify-claims step produced an empty claims array due to no_user_request_provided.
Per the fail-closed principle, this skill emits no normalization actions and no compliance verdict when input claims are absent.
To produce a valid normalized_terminology_map, a user request must be submitted so that classify-claims can produce a non-empty claims array for this step to consume.
